text:
Ana (Finance): Heads up - ACME flagged a huge drop in billed embed units for Mar 3-4. Their usage spike shows client-side retries and many 429s; billed tokens ~40% lower than ingress. Can eng confirm if legacy SDK batching could've suppressed billable events?
Mike W: I pulled a quick diff of ingress vs billing by request_id. Requests from sdk_version=0.9.2 sometimes hit the rate limiter then retried client-side with the same batch id. Server dedupe treats the retried packet as non-billable if it matches an earlier dedup key - that could explain the undercount.
Priya S: Do we have a list of affected customers/intervals? Need numbers for a credit calc.
Jo (Eng): ACME is affected. I ran a query:
```sql
SELECT count(*) as ingress_cnt, sum(billed_tokens) as billed_tokens
FROM ingress_events
WHERE client_version in ('0.9.1','0.9.2','0.9.3','0.9.4')
  AND customer_id='acme'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-03T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-05T00:00:00Z';
```
Ingress count 1,243,701 vs billed_tokens 752,344 (tokens not events) - gap ~490k tokens.
Ethan: That's material. We should avoid mass credits until we confirm replay results. Is there a raw-ingress replay to recompute billable flags?
Jo (Eng): Yes - we can replay from raw kafka topic with idempotency off and a "force-billable" mode to recompute counts. Estimate ~2h run and small S3 staging. Need backfill ticket and finance sign-off to apply credits.
Ana (Finance): Priya, can you put together a tentative credit range? If ~500k tokens, at our embed rate that's about $X (ballpark).
Priya S: On it. Also need list of invoiced periods and whether the customer already disputed.
Ana (Finance): ACME opened support INC-5421 with SDK logs showing repeated POSTs with identical batch ids during 2026-03-03T14:00-18:00Z.
Mike W: Eng note - affected SDK versions reuse batch ids on retry. Fix landed in 0.9.5 to generate new ids on retry. Suggest patching billing dedupe to prefer server request_id when present.
Jo (Eng): Short-term: backfill replay with force-billable for that customer/time window. Long-term: change dedupe semantics and emit an idempotency header.
BillingBot: New credit-request created: CR-9982 for manual review (requested_by: Ana).
Ana (Finance): Approvals needed: finance manager and VP sales for credits > $5k. Priya, estimate please.
Priya S: Preliminary estimate: missing billed tokens ~510k ±80k => estimated credit $3,800–$4,800. Will attach calc and link to replay ticket after Jo confirms run results.
Ethan: If replay yields higher deltas we should cap the max credit and open a follow-up. Also notify product + CS about messaging.
Jo (Eng): I'll run the backfill tomorrow 06:00 UTC to avoid peak. Will post logs and checksum of counts here.
Ana (Finance): Action items: (1) Jo runs replay and posts exact delta + logs; (2) Priya finalizes credit estimate and files for approval; (3) Mike/Eng ship dedupe fix in next patch and note in release notes; (4) CS drafts message to ACME explaining timeline.
Mike W: I'll prep a short changelog entry.
Priya S: Filing approval request now. Tagging @Ethan for FYI.
Ethan: Saw it, thanks. Marking this P1 for billing ops. :white_check_mark:
Ana (Finance): If anyone sees other customers on those sdk versions, flag them - we should run a broader audit after the ACME run.
Jo (Eng): Will add a job to scan top 100 customers for similar deltas.
Ana (Finance): Great - will loop in CS once we have confirmed numbers.
